papers.title: Variability in the Application and Principles of Prehabilitation and Enhanced Recovery (VAPPER Survey) Among Colorectal Surgery Units: A National Multicentre Survey
papers.authors: Cerdán Santacruz C, Carreras I Hoyos M, Domínguez Serrano I, Cano-Valderrama Ó, Reyes Díaz M, Viejo Martínez E
papers.abstract: Background: Prehabilitation has become an essential component of perioperative care in colorectal surgery, aiming to improve postoperative outcomes through multimodal interventions. However, its real-world implementation remains heterogeneous. This study aimed to evaluate the degree of implementation and variability of prehabilitation programs across colorectal surgery units in Spain. Methods: A national multicenter cross-sectional survey (VAPPER Survey) was conducted among colorectal surgery units. The questionnaire included 83 items addressing organizational structure, nutritional assessment, frailty screening, and multidisciplinary collaboration. Data were analyzed descriptively and expressed as frequencies and percentages. Results: A total of 104 hospitals participated. Prehabilitation programs were present in 79% (n = 82) of centers, while 21% (n = 22) reported no program. Nutritional screening was not performed in 21% (n = 22) of hospitals. Among those performing screening, MUST was the most frequently used tool (68%, n = 56), although considerable variability existed. Systematic use of GLIM criteria was reported in only 24% (n = 20), whereas 35% (n = 28) did not use GLIM and 41% (n = 34) applied it selectively. Frailty screening in patients ≥70 years was absent in 54% (n = 44) of centers, and geriatric involvement was limited and non-standardized. Conclusions: Prehabilitation is widely implemented in Spain but remains highly heterogeneous across all dimensions. The most relevant deficits are concentrated in systematic nutritional assessment, malnutrition diagnosis using standardized criteria, geriatric integration, and psychological support. Standardization of protocols, strengthening of multidisciplinary teams, and enhanced training in perioperative nutrition are priorities for optimizing outcomes in colorectal surgery.

papers.title_zh: 大腸直腸外科單位間術前準備(Prehabilitation)與強化恢復實務之變異性（VAPPER調查）：一項全國多中心調查
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：術前準備(Prehabilitation)已成為大腸直腸手術圍術期照護的重要環節，目的在透過多模式介入改善術後結果。然而其實際執行情況仍高度不一致。本研究旨在評估西班牙各大腸直腸外科單位中術前準備計畫的執行程度與變異性。方法：針對大腸直腸外科單位進行全國多中心橫斷面調查（VAPPER Survey）。問卷包含83個項目，涵蓋組織架構、營養評估、衰弱篩檢及多學科協作。數據以描述性統計呈現，以頻率與百分比表示。結果：共104家醫院參與。79%（n=82）的中心有術前準備計畫，21%（n=22）表示無相關計畫。21%（n=22）的醫院未進行營養篩檢。在有進行篩檢的醫院中，MUST為最常使用的工具（68%，n=56），但仍存在相當大的變異性。僅24%（n=20）系統性使用GLIM準則，35%（n=28）未使用GLIM，41%（n=34）僅選擇性使用。54%（n=44）的中心未對≥70歲病患進行衰弱篩檢，老年醫學介入有限且未標準化。結論：術前準備在西班牙已廣泛實施，但在所有面向上仍高度異質。最相關的缺失集中在系統性營養評估、使用標準化準則診斷營養不良、老年醫學整合及心理支持。標準化流程、強化多學科團隊，以及加強圍術期營養訓練，為優化大腸直腸手術結果之優先事項。

papers.title: Differences in quality of life between early onset colorectal cancer patients compared to older patients: a qualitative study
papers.journal_full: Quality of life research : an international journal of quality of life aspects of treatment, care and rehabilitation
papers.authors: Tucker J, Turner B, Harrison A, Chamberlain R, Raju D, Murphy E
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: Colorectal (bowel) cancer and its treatment can seriously affect a person's quality of life, including physical, social, work‑related, and emotional wellbeing. Young people with colorectal cancer experience worse psychological wellbeing, including marked emotional distress and prominent levels of anxiety. This disease is less common in people under 50, but cases of early‑onset colorectal cancer (EOCRC) are rising around the world. The object of this research was to derive a deeper understanding of the challenges and impact on quality of life faced by EOCRC compared to older patients following a colorectal cancer diagnosis.
METHOD: Recruitment of participants from a larger mixed method project of surviving EOCRC patients from 2013 to 2023 and a matched sample of colorectal cancer patients. 1 Participants invited to take part in an in‑depth semi-structured interview conducted by telephone or virtual meeting and audio taped, transcribed, and analysed using an interpretive phenomenological approach.
RESULTS: Twenty participants participated in interviews. Three themes (Headspace, physical impact and future) and eight corresponding sub themes encompassing poorer psychological quality of life, emotional distress and heightened anxiety faced by EOCRC. Barriers in current diagnostic services and treatment pathways more often reported by EOCRC.
CONCLUSION: Older and younger cancer patients highlight a shift from active to passive social roles with both groups reporting substantial reductions in overall quality of life and role functioning, but longer lasting impact for EOCRC, who are focused on family, fertility, career, and survival. A review of current diagnostic services and treatment pathways is required, tailoring care for all patients and importantly address the unique needs of EOCRC.
Colorectal (bowel) cancer and its treatment can seriously affect a person’s QoL, including physical, social, work‑related, and emotional wellbeing. It is still less common in people under 50, but cases of early‑onset colorectal cancer are rising around the world.Younger adults are often building careers, forming long‑term relationships, and raising families, so cancer can disrupt their lives in separate ways than it does for older people. Research so far has not fully explored these differences, but this study shows that a colorectal cancer diagnosis and its treatment have a particularly strong negative impact on the QoL of younger patients.Young people with colorectal cancer tend to experience worse psychological wellbeing, including marked emotional distress and elevated levels of anxiety. These findings highlight the need for diagnostic services and treatment pathways to be better tailored to support all people with colorectal cancer, and to specifically address the unique needs of those under 50 years of age.
papers.title_zh: 早發性大腸直腸癌(EOCRC)患者與年長患者生活品質差異之質性研究
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：大腸直腸癌及其治療會嚴重影響患者的生活品質，包括生理、社會、工作與情緒層面。年輕大腸直腸癌患者的心理健康較差，包含明顯的情緒困擾與焦慮程度升高。此疾病在50歲以下人群中較少見，但全球早發性大腸直腸癌(EOCRC)病例正在增加。本研究目的為深入了解EOCRC患者相較於年長患者，在大腸直腸癌診斷後所面臨的挑戰與對生活品質的影響。

方法：參與者招募自一項2013年至2023年EOCRC存活者的較大型混合方法研究，並配對一組大腸直腸癌患者樣本。邀請參與者以電話或視訊會議方式進行深度半結構式訪談，錄音、轉錄後以詮釋現象學方法分析。

結果：共20位參與者參與訪談。歸納出三大主題（心理空間、生理影響、未來）及八個對應的次主題，涵蓋EOCRC患者面臨的較差心理生活品質、情緒困擾與升高的焦慮。EOCRC患者更常回報目前診斷服務與治療路徑存在障礙。

結論：年長與年輕癌症患者皆呈現從主動轉為被動社會角色的轉變，兩組皆回報整體生活品質與角色功能顯著下降，但EOCRC患者的影響持續時間較長，且更聚焦於家庭、生育、職涯與存活。需要檢討現行診斷服務與治療路徑，為所有患者量身打造照護，並特別關注EOCRC患者的獨特需求。

（患者摘要）大腸直腸癌及其治療會嚴重影響生活品質，包括生理、社會、工作與情緒層面。此病在50歲以下人群中仍屬少見，但全球早發性大腸直腸癌病例正在增加。年輕成人通常正處於建立職涯、發展長期關係與養育家庭的階段，因此癌症對他們生活的衝擊方式與年長患者不同。目前研究尚未充分探討這些差異，但本研究顯示大腸直腸癌診斷及其治療對年輕患者的生活品質有特別強烈的負面影響。年輕大腸直腸癌患者往往經歷較差的心理健康，包括明顯的情緒困擾與升高的焦慮程度。這些發現凸顯診斷服務與治療路徑需要更好地量身打造以支持所有大腸直腸癌患者，並特別因應50歲以下患者的獨特需求。

papers.title: Comparative Structure-Based Analysis of Predicted BZD9L1 Binding Modes Across Human Sirtuins
papers.authors: Tan Y, Lee Y, Oon C, Mancera R
papers.abstract: Sirtuins (SIRTs) are NAD+-dependent enzymes implicated in cancer and other diseases, but the high conservation of their catalytic sites complicates the development of isoform-selective inhibitors. BZD9L1 is a benzimidazole-based sirtuin inhibitor with previously reported activity against SIRT1 and SIRT2. However, its potential interactions with other human sirtuin isoforms remain incompletely characterized. Here, we applied a comparative structure-based modelling framework integrating homology modelling, molecular docking, and targeted experimental assessment to investigate plausible binding modes of BZD9L1 across human SIRT1-7. Docking predicted that BZD9L1 could occupy the ADP-ribose cofactor-binding region of all seven isoforms, with broadly conserved orientations but differences in the predicted interaction networks. Hydrogen-bonding and π-mediated contacts predominated in the selected SIRT1-3 poses, whereas hydrophobic contacts were more apparent in several selected SIRT4-7 poses. The modest differences in docking scores were interpreted qualitatively and do not establish differential binding affinities or isoform selectivity. In colorectal cancer cells, BZD9L1 treatment altered acetyl-SOD2 levels, consistent with altered SIRT3-associated deacetylation in a cellular context. In a separate cell-free enzymatic assay, no measurable SIRT5 inhibition was detected under the conditions tested. These complementary assays provided distinct, independently interpreted readouts of SIRT3-associated cellular activity and SIRT5 enzymatic activity. Collectively, this study provides testable structural hypotheses regarding BZD9L1 recognition by human sirtuins and identifies interaction features that may guide subsequent biochemical and structure-based investigations.
papers.title_zh: 基於結構的比較分析：BZD9L1在人類Sirtuin家族中的預測結合模式
papers.abstract_zh: Sirtuins (SIRTs) 是一類NAD+依賴性酶，與癌症及其他疾病相關，但其催化位點的高度保守性使得開發同工型選擇性抑制劑變得困難。BZD9L1是一種苯并咪唑類sirtuin抑制劑，先前已報導對SIRT1與SIRT2具有活性，然而其與其他人類sirtuin同工型的潛在交互作用尚未完全闡明。在本研究中，我們應用整合同源模建、分子對接與針對性實驗評估的比較結構基礎建模框架，探討BZD9L1在人類SIRT1-7中可能的結合模式。分子對接預測BZD9L1可佔據所有七種同工型的ADP-ribose輔因子結合區域，整體方向大致保守，但預測的交互作用網絡有所差異。在所選的SIRT1-3構象中，氫鍵與π介導的接觸為主；而在多個所選SIRT4-7構象中，疏水性接觸較為明顯。對接分數的些微差異僅作定性解讀，並不能確立不同的結合親和力或同工型選擇性。在大腸直腸癌細胞中，BZD9L1處理改變了acetyl-SOD2水平，與SIRT3相關去乙醯化在細胞背景下的改變一致。在另一項無細胞的酵素分析中，於測試條件下未檢測到可測量的SIRT5抑制作用。這些互補性分析提供了獨立解讀的SIRT3相關細胞活性與SIRT5酵素活性的不同讀值。總體而言，本研究提供了關於人類sirtuins辨識BZD9L1的可驗證結構假說，並識別出可能指引後續生化與結構基礎研究的交互作用特徵。

papers.title: Genetic Ancestry and Colorectal Cancer in the All of Us Dataset
papers.authors: Chatzipanagiotou O, Charalampous C, Cordle A, Elemosho A, Alizai Q, Mevawalla A
papers.abstract:
IMPORTANCE: Genetic ancestry may complement biological, behavioral, and clinical factors in understanding colorectal cancer (CRC) disparities; yet, ancestry-informed analyses in CRC remain limited.
OBJECTIVE: To characterize associations of genetic ancestry with CRC burden, age at diagnosis, and age-specific risk, and to develop a multiethnic CRC risk-prediction model.
DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This retrospective cohort study used All of Us data from July 1986 to October 2023, with follow-up through last visit or death (median [IQR], 133.1 [57.1-186.5] months); analyses were conducted from February to June 2026. All of Us is a US research cohort with linked electronic health record (EHR) and short-read whole-genome sequencing (srWGS) data. All of Us Research Program participants with srWGS and linked EHR data were included, except those with hereditary polyposis or Lynch syndrome.
EXPOSURES: Genetically inferred ancestry categories and principal components.
MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Any CRC was the primary outcome. Associations were evaluated using Fisher exact tests, cumulative incidence functions with Gray tests, cause-specific and Fine-Gray subdistribution hazard models, and pooled multivariable logistic regression. Prediction models used penalized least absolute shrinkage and selection operator and extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost).
RESULTS: Among 316 624 participants (median [IQR] age, 56.3 [40.2-68.2] years; 172 327 [54.4%] of European ancestry; 191 705 female [61.2%]; 121 585 male [38.8%]), 2914 (0.9%) developed CRC. European ancestry was associated with higher odds of CRC vs all other ancestries combined (odds ratio, 1.50; 95% CI, 1.39-1.62). The median age at CRC diagnosis was older in European (63.4 [53.9-71.2] years) than in American admixed-Latino, African, East Asian, and Other ancestry groups. In cause-specific hazard models on the attained-age scale, American admixed-Latino (hazard ratio, 1.30; 95% CI, 1.14-1.47) and East Asian (hazard ratio, 1.43; 95% CI, 1.06-1.94) ancestry had higher age-specific CRC hazard than European ancestry, with consistent findings on the subdistribution scale accounting for competing death. The multiethnic XGBoost model performed best (receiver operating characteristic area under the curve, 0.898; 95% CI, 0.882-0.912; precision-recall area under the curve, 0.338; 95% CI, 0.296-0.379) and was well calibrated.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this cohort study, genetic ancestry was associated with meaningful differences in CRC burden and age-specific risk. These findings suggest that a multiethnic XGBoost model may complement CRC screening as a risk-enrichment tool.

papers.title_zh: All of Us 資料庫中基因血統（Genetic Ancestry）與大腸直腸癌之關聯
papers.abstract_zh:
重要性：基因血統可能有助於補充生物、行為與臨床因子，以理解大腸直腸癌（CRC）的健康不平等；然而，CRC 中以血統為基礎的分析仍相對有限。
目的：探討基因血統與 CRC 負擔、診斷年齡及年齡特異性風險之關聯，並建立多族群 CRC 風險預測模型。
設計、場域與參與者：本回溯性世代研究使用 All of Us 資料庫（1986年7月至2023年10月），追蹤至最後一次就診或死亡（中位數[IQR] 133.1[57.1-186.5]個月）；分析於2026年2月至6月間進行。All of Us 為美國研究世代，具連結之電子病歷（EHR）與短讀長全基因體測序（srWGS）資料。納入 All of Us 研究計畫中具 srWGS 及連結 EHR 資料之參與者，排除遺傳性多發性息肉症或 Lynch 症候群患者。
暴露因子：基因推論之血統分類與主成分。
主要結果與測量：主要結果為任何 CRC。以 Fisher 精確檢定、累積發生函數搭配 Gray 檢定、病因特異性與 Fine-Gray 次分布風險模型，以及聯合多變量邏輯回歸進行關聯評估。預測模型採用懲罰式最小絕對收縮選擇算子（LASSO）與極限梯度提升（XGBoost）。
結果：在 316,624 名參與者中（中位數[IQR]年齡 56.3[40.2-68.2]歲；172,327人[54.4%]為歐洲血統；191,705名女性[61.2%]；121,585名男性[38.8%]），2,914人（0.9%）罹患 CRC。相較於所有其他血統合併，歐洲血統與較高的 CRC 勝算相關（勝算比1.50；95% CI, 1.39-1.62）。歐洲血統 CRC 診斷之中位年齡（63.4[53.9-71.2]歲）較美洲混血拉丁裔、非洲、東亞及其他血統族群為高。以病因特異性風險模型（依達到年齡尺度）分析，美洲混血拉丁裔（風險比1.30；95% CI, 1.14-1.47）與東亞（風險比1.43；95% CI, 1.06-1.94）血統之年齡特異性 CRC 風險高於歐洲血統，於考慮競爭死亡風險之次分布尺度分析亦得一致結果。多族群 XGBoost 模型表現最佳（ROC 曲線下面積0.898；95% CI, 0.882-0.912；精確率-召回率曲線下面積0.338；95% CI, 0.296-0.379），且校準良好。
結論與相關性：在此世代研究中，基因血統與 CRC 負擔及年齡特異性風險之顯著差異相關。此結果顯示多族群 XGBoost 模型可作為 CRC 篩檢之風險強化輔助工具。

papers.title: National Cancer Institute-Supported Obesity and Cancer Research, 2015-2022
papers.authors: Dwyer L, Agurs-Collins T, Bailey C, Wolff-Hughes D, Czajkowski S, Reedy J
papers.abstract:
IMPORTANCE: The National Cancer Institute's (NCI) interest in obesity and cancer reflects associations of obesity with cancer incidence, as well as potential impacts of obesity on cancer treatment, survivorship, recurrence, and survival. Given the growing prevalence of obesity and its implications for cancer burden, understanding the historical scope and direction of research in this area informs future needs.
OBJECTIVE: To describe trends in obesity and cancer research supported by the NCI over an 8-year period preceding the widespread uptake of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists and discuss scientific gaps and opportunities to guide research priorities in a rapidly evolving therapeutic landscape.
EVIDENCE REVIEW: Newly funded NCI grants in obesity from fiscal years (FYs) 2015 to 2022 were obtained from searching the publicly available National Institutes of Health (NIH) Reporter for the NIH obesity spending category. During 2023 to 2024, 2 coders independently categorized grants by areas of scientific focus and summarized funding trends over time.
FINDINGS: From FY 2015 to FY 2022, the newly funded obesity portfolio included 348 grants, and the number of NCI-supported grants focusing on obesity ranged from 38 to 59 new awards each year. An uptick in the number of new awards in FY 2022 was aligned with several funding opportunities relevant to obesity. Common research focus areas within this obesity and cancer portfolio included mechanistic (125 grants [49.4%]) and behavioral (96 grants [37.9%]) research, with breast cancer (54 of 162 grants [33.3%]) and colorectal cancer (30 of 162 grants [18.5%]) being the most heavily studied.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this descriptive study of the FYs 2015 to 2022 obesity and cancer grants portfolio, results showed that the NCI has consistently supported study of this critical research area, establishing a strong evidence base. Understanding the complex intersection of obesity and cancer requires sustained, multidisciplinary research. Multiple opportunities exist for advancing the science, including less studied areas, such as obesity's impact on cancer treatment and survivorship, obesity and cancer throughout the lifespan, obesity and cancer disparities, and the study of obesity as it relates to multiple cancer sites; additionally, as use of GLP-1 medications continues to expand, new opportunities may emerge to examine how intentional, pharmacologically induced weight loss may influence cancer risk, treatment response, and survivorship.
papers.title_zh: 美國國家癌症研究院支持之肥胖與癌症研究概況，2015-2022年
papers.abstract_zh:
重要性：美國國家癌症研究院（NCI）對肥胖與癌症的關注，反映出肥胖與癌症發生率的關聯，以及肥胖對癌症治療、存活照護、復發與存活的潛在影響。鑑於肥胖盛行率持續上升及其對癌症負擔的影響，了解此領域研究的歷史範疇與方向有助於規劃未來需求。

目的：描述NCI在GLP-1受體促效劑廣泛使用前8年間所支持之肥胖與癌症研究趨勢，並討論科學缺口與機會，以指引在快速演變治療格局下的研究優先順序。

papers.title: Gut microbiota dysbiosis and immune responses: insights from IgA nephropathy and inflammatory bowel disease
papers.authors: Yi L, Zhang R, Yang Y, Wen X, Wang Y, Zeng F
papers.abstract: IgA nephropathy (IgAN) is the most common glomerulonephritis worldwide, and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) comprises a group of chronic, relapsing inflammatory bowel disorders. Although IgAN and IBD differ in clinical manifestations, both involve interactions among genetic susceptibility, epigenetic abnormalities, and gut microbiota dysbiosis, ultimately pointing to mucosal immune dysregulation and chronic inflammation. They share similar alterations in gut microecology, characterized by a reduction in short-chain fatty acid-producing protective commensals and an increase in pathogenic symbionts. This leads to intestinal barrier disruption and aberrant microbial metabolites, promoting the production of galactose-deficient IgA1 (Gd-IgA1), activating intestinal mucosal immune cells, and driving both local and systemic inflammation. Notably, glucocorticoids (GC) and immunomodulators are common therapeutic agents for both diseases, and effective treatment is accompanied by restoration of the gut microbiota and improvement of immune imbalance. The four currently marketed budesonide enteric-coated capsules employ pH-dependent targeted-release technology and act on different sites ranging from the terminal ileum to the colon to modulate B-cell activation and attenuate local inflammation. IgAN and IBD may be closely related mucosal immune disorders, with immune inflammation associated with gut microbiota dysbiosis may represent a key link between them. Furthermore, upper respiratory tract infection may participate in the development of IgAN through mucosal immunity. The efficacy of tonsillectomy as a therapeutic intervention suggests the existence of crosstalk between the respiratory tract and the kidneys.

papers.title_zh: 腸道菌群失調與免疫反應：來自IgA腎病變與發炎性腸道疾病的洞見
papers.abstract_zh: IgA腎病變（IgAN）是全球最常見的腎絲球腎炎，而發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）則涵蓋一組慢性、復發性的腸道發炎疾病。儘管IgAN與IBD在臨床表現上不同，兩者皆涉及遺傳易感性、表觀遺傳異常與腸道菌群失調之間的交互作用，最終導致黏膜免疫失調與慢性發炎。兩者在腸道微生態上有相似的變化特徵，即產生短鏈脂肪酸的保護性共生菌減少，而致病性共生菌增加。這導致腸道屏障破壞與異常微生物代謝物產生，促進缺半乳糖IgA1（Gd-IgA1）的生成，活化腸黏膜免疫細胞，並驅動局部與全身性發炎。值得注意的是，糖皮質激素（GC）與免疫調節劑是兩種疾病常見的治療藥物，有效治療伴隨著腸道菌群的恢復與免疫失衡的改善。目前市售的四種布地奈德腸溶膠囊採用pH依賴性標靶釋放技術，作用於從迴腸末端到結腸的不同部位，以調節B細胞活化並減輕局部發炎。IgAN與IBD可能是密切相關的黏膜免疫疾病，與腸道菌群失調相關的免疫發炎可能是連結兩者的關鍵環節。此外，上呼吸道感染可能透過黏膜免疫參與IgAN的發病；扁桃腺切除術的療效顯示呼吸道與腎臟之間存在相互作用（crosstalk）。

papers.authors: Mosallanejad K, Hubeau C, Schwartz Sterman A, Tan Y
papers.abstract: Tissue repair and regeneration are highly coordinated multicellular processes that rely on the active resolution of inflammation rather than merely its passive cessation. Reciprocal orchestration among stromal, innate, and adaptive immune systems is key to maintaining or restoring tissue homeostasis from pathological perturbations. Macrophages serve as a central nexus of these responses, exhibiting dynamic functional plasticity that extends beyond dichotomous M1/M2 classification. This review explores the evolving, context-dependent roles of macrophages in restoring tissue homeostasis, with a particular focus on efferocytosis and subsequent metabolic rewiring as key drivers of inflammation resolution. Furthermore, we highlight the bi-directional crosstalk between macrophages and heterogeneous fibroblast populations. While these stromal-myeloid interactions are essential for transient matrix remodeling and physiological healing, their sustained activation under inflammatory conditions drives maladaptive repair and fibrotic remodeling. We discuss how the defects and dysregulation of these cellular circuits contribute to the pathogenesis of autoimmune disorders, as exemplified by recent findings in rheumatoid arthritis (RA), systemic sclerosis (SSc), and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). Finally, we evaluate emerging "resolution therapies" that aim to harness endogenous tissue-reparative programs of macrophages therapeutically to treat autoimmune diseases, including the application of specialized pro-resolving mediators (SPMs) and macrophage reprogramming strategies.

papers.abstract_zh: 組織修復與再生是高度協調的多細胞過程，仰賴發炎的主動消退，而非單純的被動停止。基質細胞、先天性與後天性免疫系統之間的相互協調，是維持或恢復組織恆定、對抗病理性擾動的關鍵。巨噬細胞是這些反應的核心樞紐，展現出超越傳統M1/M2二分法的動態功能可塑性。本綜述探討巨噬細胞在恢復組織恆定中不斷演變、依情境而定的角色，特別聚焦於efferocytosis（凋亡細胞清除）及其後續的代謝重塑，作為驅動發炎消退的關鍵機制。此外，我們強調巨噬細胞與異質性纖維母細胞群之間的雙向對話。雖然這些基質-骨髓細胞交互作用對於暫時性基質重塑與生理性癒合是必要的，但在發炎狀態下持續活化將導致不良修復與纖維化重塑。我們討論這些細胞迴路的缺陷與失調如何促成自體免疫疾病的病理機制，並以類風濕性關節炎（RA）、全身性硬化症（SSc）與發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）的最新研究發現為例。最後，我們評估新興的「消退療法」，旨在治療性地利用巨噬細胞內生的組織修復程式來治療自體免疫疾病，包括特化促消退介質（SPMs）的應用與巨噬細胞重編程策略。

papers.title: Current Status of Intestinal Stem Cell Research: Mechanisms, Intestinal Diseases, and Organoid Development
papers.authors: Li Y, Lai R, He Y, Cheng K, Cheng L, Yi J
papers.abstract: Intestinal stem cells (ISCs) are essential for maintaining intestinal homeostasis and repairing injury, and have garnered extensive attention in recent years. ISC research has not only advanced our understanding of intestinal physiology but also revealed pathological roles of ISCs in diseases and facilitated the identification of potential targeted therapies. This review aims to comprehensively present the current state of ISC research. It elaborates on the multi-level regulatory mechanisms governing ISCs, including niche cells, signaling pathways, gut microbiota, extracellular matrix, and epigenetic regulation. It further summarizes the involvement of ISCs in colorectal cancer, inflammatory bowel disease, radiation-induced intestinal injury, and short bowel syndrome, as well as their application in organoid technology. Finally, this review highlights future directions, including dissecting how distinct cellular states and microenvironments dynamically regulate ISC function, and the integration of cutting-edge technologies like microfluidic organ-on-a-chip and gene editing technologies to accelerate the translation of basic discoveries into clinical practice, thereby providing a valuable reference for researchers in the field.

papers.title: Serotonin as a Regulator of Innate and Adaptive Immunity: Mechanisms and Clinical Relevance in Inflammatory Disease
papers.authors: Inozemtsev V, Shashkovskaya V, Sergunova V
papers.abstract: Serotonin (5-hydroxytryptamine, 5-HT) is traditionally considered a neurotransmitter, but most of the body's serotonin is peripheral and participates in vascular, hemostatic, inflammatory, and immune processes. This review summarizes current evidence on the role of peripheral serotonin in innate and adaptive immunity and evaluates its clinical relevance in inflammatory and immune-mediated diseases. The article synthesizes experimental and clinical data on serotonin sources, 5-HT receptors, SERT, serotonylation, and 5-HT-dependent regulation of neutrophils, monocytes/macrophages, mast cells, dendritic cells, T cells, and B cells. The reviewed data indicate that serotonin modulates leukocyte recruitment, platelet-immune interactions, NETosis, macrophage polarization, dendritic cell-T-cell communication, lymphocyte activation, vascular permeability, and tissue remodeling. Clinically, serotonergic mechanisms are implicated in sepsis, inflammatory bowel disease, autoimmune disorders, cardiovascular inflammation, thromboinflammation, and the tumor microenvironment. However, the direction of 5-HT effects is not uniform and depends on receptor subtype, cell type, local mediator concentration, disease stage, and tissue context. Serotonin should therefore be regarded as a context-dependent immunoregulatory mediator rather than an exclusively pro- or anti-inflammatory factor. Further studies are needed to standardize clinical measurements of serotonin and its metabolites and to define therapeutically relevant serotonergic targets.
papers.title_zh: 血清素作為先天性與後天性免疫的調節者：發炎性疾病中的機轉與臨床意義
papers.abstract_zh: 血清素（5-hydroxytryptamine, 5-HT）傳統上被視為神經傳導物質，但體內大部分血清素位於周邊，參與血管、止血、發炎與免疫過程。本篇綜述總結了周邊血清素在先天性與後天性免疫中角色的現有證據，並評估其在發炎性與免疫介導疾病中的臨床意義。文章綜合了血清素來源、5-HT受體、SERT（血清素轉運蛋白）、血清素化（serotonylation），以及5-HT依賴性調控嗜中性球、單核球/巨噬細胞、肥大細胞、樹突狀細胞、T細胞與B細胞的實驗與臨床數據。文獻回顧顯示，血清素可調節白血球募集、血小板-免疫細胞交互作用、NETosis（嗜中性球網狀陷阱形成）、巨噬細胞極化、樹突狀細胞與T細胞的溝通、淋巴球活化、血管通透性及組織重塑。在臨床上，血清素相關機轉與敗血症、發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）、自體免疫疾病、心血管發炎、血栓發炎（thromboinflammation）以及腫瘤微環境有關。然而，5-HT效應的方向並非一致，取決於受體亞型、細胞類型、局部媒介物濃度、疾病階段及組織環境。因此血清素應被視為一種情境依賴性（context-dependent）的免疫調節因子，而非單純的促發炎或抗發炎因子。未來需要進一步研究以標準化血清素及其代謝物的臨床測量方法，並定義具治療意義的血清素相關靶點。

papers.title: Prehabilitation in Colorectal Cancer Surgery: A Narrative Review of Current Evidence and Clinical Perspectives
papers.authors: Zierkiewicz D, Manulik S, Chudiak A, Krówczyńska D, Homola W, Pobrotyn P
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Surgical treatment of colorectal cancer (CRC) is associated with a substantial risk of postoperative complications and delayed recovery of functional capacity, particularly in older patients and those with multiple comorbidities. Preoperative prehabilitation has emerged as a strategy aimed at optimizing patients' physical, nutritional, and psychological status prior to surgery; however, its clinical effectiveness and feasibility of implementation remain subjects of ongoing debate. The aim of this narrative review was to provide a clinically oriented synthesis of current evidence regarding multimodal prehabilitation in patients undergoing CRC surgery, with particular emphasis on perioperative outcomes, functional recovery, nutritional optimization, and implementation-related considerations. Methods: A targeted narrative review of the peer-reviewed literature indexed in PubMed (2015-2025) was conducted to identify contemporary review-type publications, including narrative reviews, systematic reviews, scoping reviews, and meta-analyses, addressing prehabilitation in CRC surgery. The findings were synthesized narratively and interpreted with emphasis on clinical applicability and translational relevance. Results: Twenty contemporary review publications were included in the analysis. Across the included publications, the most frequently reported favorable effects were observed for multimodal prehabilitation, incorporating physical exercise, nutritional support, and a psychological component. These interventions were associated with improvements in functional capacity and, in some meta-analyses, with a reduction in postoperative complication rates and shorter length of hospital stay, particularly in high-risk patients. Prehabilitation was assessed as safe and well tolerated. Conclusions: The current body of evidence indicates that multimodal prehabilitation may constitute a beneficial adjunct, particularly in improving functional capacity, while its impact on hard postoperative outcomes remains closely dependent on intervention quality, appropriate patient selection, and seamless integration with established perioperative care pathways. Future meta-analyses should address underexplored components of prehabilitation, including preparation for stoma formation and targeted educational and psychological support related to sexual health.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目的：大腸直腸癌（CRC）之手術治療伴隨相當高的術後併發症風險及功能恢復延遲，尤其是高齡及多重共病患者。術前強化（prehabilitation）已成為一種旨在於手術前優化病人生理、營養與心理狀態的策略；然而其臨床效益及執行可行性仍存在爭議。本敘事性回顧之目的，是針對接受CRC手術病患之多模式術前強化，提供以臨床為導向的當前證據綜整，特別著重於圍術期結果、功能恢復、營養優化及執行相關考量。方法：針對PubMed（2015-2025）收錄之同儕審查文獻進行目標性敘事回顧，納入探討CRC手術術前強化之當代回顧型文獻，包括敘事性回顧、系統性回顧、範疇回顧及統合分析。研究結果以敘事方式綜整，並著重於臨床適用性及轉譯相關性進行詮釋。結果：共納入20篇當代回顧文獻。在所納入的文獻中，最常被報告出現有利效果的是結合體能運動、營養支持及心理層面之多模式術前強化。這些介入與功能容量的改善相關，且部分統合分析顯示可降低術後併發症發生率並縮短住院天數，尤其在高風險病患中更為明顯。術前強化被評估為安全且耐受性良好。結論：目前的證據體顯示，多模式術前強化可能是一項有益的輔助措施，特別是在改善功能容量方面，而其對於「硬性」術後結果的影響，仍高度取決於介入品質、適當的病人篩選，以及與既有圍術期照護路徑的無縫整合。未來的統合分析應探討術前強化中尚未充分研究的部分，包括造口準備以及與性健康相關的針對性衛教與心理支持。

papers.title: Whole and Sprouted Cereals as Nutritional Modulators of the Gut Microbiota and Intestinal Inflammation in IBD
papers.authors: Álvarez-Arraño V, Toledo-Stuardo K, Campmans-Kuijpers M, Magne F, Hermoso M
papers.abstract: Ulcerative colitis (UC) and Crohn's disease (CD), known as inflammatory bowel diseases (IBDs), result from a complex interaction of genetic, immunological, microbial and environmental factors. There is growing evidence suggesting that imbalances in the gut microbiota, or dysbiosis, play a causal role in IBD and are strongly influenced by aspects of the Western lifestyle. Diet is an important modulator of gut health, and whole cereals have attracted attention for their potential to positively shape gut microbiota and intestinal function. Germination further enhances the content of prebiotic substrates and bioactive compounds such as polyphenols, GABA and fiber, which may modulate inflammation, oxidative stress and immune responses. In vitro and clinical studies suggest that these compounds may reduce pro-inflammatory cytokines and improve symptoms in IBD, although robust evidence in patients is still lacking. Here, we provide an overview of whole and sprouted cereals and their effects on inflammation and gut microbiota, with particular focus on IBD. We also discuss the potential of sprouted grains as a complementary approach to diet alongside conventional therapy, highlighting their possible support to gut health to mitigate inflammation. Finally, we emphasize the need for further well-designed clinical studies to confirm their therapeutic potential and to better understand the mechanisms underlying their beneficial effects.

papers.title: Association Between the Dietary Inflammatory Index (DII) and Head and Neck Cancer Incidence-A Narrative Review
papers.abstract: Head and neck cancer (HNC) comprises a heterogeneous group of tumours, most often of squamous cell origin, characterized by both high morbidity and mortality rates. It is the seventh most common form of cancer diagnosed in humans, accounting for approximately 4.7% of all cancers. Among HNCs, neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is predicted to become the most common form of human cancer. Some sources include oesophagus (ESCC) in this group due to their similar histology, being described as upper aerodigestive tract cancers (UADT). Unfortunately, 60-70% of cases are diagnosed late, i.e., at clinical stages III-IV. As a result, despite modern surgical techniques and oncological treatments, the survival rate remains below 40-60% due to frequent lymph node metastases and local tumour recurrence. There is a growing concern that diet and inflammatory dietary components may influence the initiation and development of HNSCC. The inflammatory potential of diets can be quantified by the Dietary Inflammatory Index (DII). The DII was derived from an analysis of 45 dietary constituents that either increase or decrease inflammation. Several recent clinical studies have noted a significant relationship between DII score and many inflammation-associated chronic diseases, such as obesity, cardiovascular and neurodegenerative disorders, and diabetes, and the incidence of various human cancers, i.e., prostate, ovarian, breast, colorectal cancer, and HNC. However, few studies have investigated the relationship between DII and HNSCC, with most being limited to observational, case-control, and cross-sectional studies. Therefore, the aim of this narrative review is to present the substantial oncological aspects of DII, discuss the use of DII and its modification, the Energy-Adjusted Dietary Inflammatory Index (E-DII), as indicators of HNSCC risk. It also introduces key diet-induced pro- and anti-inflammatory mechanisms and the cellular molecular signalling pathways determining the carcinogenesis of HNSCC. It provides a comprehensive overview of the current literature, including key opinion-forming systematic reviews, as well as molecular, observational, cross-sectional and case-control studies, all of which are accessible via scholarly databases such as PubMed/EMBASE/Web of Science. Thus, the work serves as a compendium of up-to-date knowledge on the relationship between DII/ED-II score and HNSCC etiopathogenesis and the influence of a diet-induced persistent inflammatory microenvironment.
papers.title_zh: 飲食發炎指數（DII）與頭頸癌發生率之關聯－敘述性文獻回顧
papers.abstract_zh: 頭頸癌（HNC）是一組異質性腫瘤，多為鱗狀細胞來源，具有高罹病率與高死亡率。它是人類第七常見的癌症，約占所有癌症的4.7%。在頭頸癌中，頭頸部鱗狀細胞癌（HNSCC）預測將成為人類最常見的癌症形式之一。部分文獻因組織學相似，將食道癌（ESCC）納入此類別，統稱為上消化呼吸道癌（UADT）。不幸的是，60-70%的病例在臨床第III-IV期才被診斷出來。因此，儘管有現代手術技術與腫瘤治療，因淋巴結轉移與局部腫瘤復發頻繁，存活率仍低於40-60%。越來越多人關注飲食與發炎性飲食成分可能影響HNSCC的發生與發展。飲食的發炎潛力可以用飲食發炎指數（DII）來量化。DII是根據45種會增加或降低發炎反應的飲食成分分析所得出。近期多項臨床研究已注意到DII分數與許多發炎相關慢性疾病（如肥胖、心血管與神經退化性疾病、糖尿病）以及多種人類癌症（如前列腺癌、卵巢癌、乳癌、大腸直腸癌與HNC）發生率之間存在顯著關聯。然而，探討DII與HNSCC關係的研究甚少，且大多限於觀察性、病例對照與橫斷面研究。因此，本敘述性文獻回顧的目的在於呈現DII的重要腫瘤學面向，討論DII及其修正版本－能量調整飲食發炎指數（E-DII）作為HNSCC風險指標的應用。本文也介紹了飲食誘發之促發炎與抗發炎的關鍵機制，以及決定HNSCC致癌過程的細胞分子訊號路徑。本文提供對現有文獻的全面性概述，包括具意見領導地位的系統性回顧，以及分子、觀察性、橫斷面與病例對照研究，這些文獻皆可透過PubMed/EMBASE/Web of Science等學術資料庫取得。因此，本文可作為關於DII/E-DII分數與HNSCC致病機轉之關係，以及飲食誘發持續性發炎微環境影響之最新知識彙編。

papers.title: The past, present, and future treatment of BRAFV600-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer: A comprehensive review
papers.authors: Dirven I, Ang C, Bertels C, Kortbeek K, de Haar-Holleman A, Vollebergh M
papers.abstract: BRAFV600-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer comprises a biologically distinct and clinically aggressive subset of metastatic colorectal cancer. Early attempts to apply single-agent BRAFV600 inhibition failed because of rapid acquired resistance and reactivation of mitogen-activated protein kinase signaling. Over the last decade, rational combinations (BRAF inhibitors and epidermal growth factor receptor inhibitors with or without mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase inhibitors) have become the standard of care in the refractory setting and are now being evaluated upfront, whereas a wave of next-generation approaches (extracellular signal-regulated kinase and SHP2 inhibitors, receptor tyrosine kinase-targeted agents, and immunotherapy combinations) aims to prevent or overcome resistance. The objective of this comprehensive review was to summarize historic therapeutic approaches, current standards, and the mechanistic rationale and clinical development of next-generation strategies to combat resistance in BRAFV600-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer.

papers.title: Oral microbiome contribution in colorectal carcinogenesis: polymicrobial interactions and virulence determinants
papers.journal_full: Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology
papers.authors: Glazunova E, Astakhova L, Kurnosov A, Doludin Y, Lyundup A, Kostin A
papers.abstract: The contribution of the microbiome to sporadic colorectal cancer (CRC) has traditionally been interpreted through the detection of individual tumor-enriched taxa or isolated virulence factors. However, accumulating evidence indicates that CRC-associated microorganisms often act as structured polymicrobial consortia rather than as independent agents. This review proposes an expanded ecological framework for understanding the role of oral taxa in colorectal carcinogenesis. Oral bacteria, including genera Fusobacterium, Parvimonas, Peptostreptococcus, Porphyromonas, Prevotella, Streptococcus, and related taxa, may translocate to the colorectal niche through enteral or hematogenous routes and establish tumor-associated communities that partially recapitulate the structural organization and succession patterns of oral biofilms. Within these communities, Fusobacterium nucleatum serves as the primary bridging organism, facilitating interspecies adhesion and spatial organization. Parvimonas micra, Porphyromonas gingivalis, and Candida albicans display potential bridging structural and functional properties, with their roles in cooperative pathogenicity and tumor progression supported by substantial experimental evidence. We integrate three complementary conceptual frameworks: oral microbial complexes (gut co-abundance groups), bridging organisms and the extended driver-passenger model of CRC. This synthesis supports a shift from taxonomy-centered interpretation toward a functional virulome-based view, in which the role of a taxon is defined by its ecological position, interaction network, and virulence determinants. Key oral virulence factors contribute to biofilm formation, epithelial adhesion and invasion, barrier disruption, immune evasion, inflammatory modulation, metabolic remodeling of the tumor microenvironment, and metastatic potential. Because the composition of translocated oral consortia changes gradually within the colorectal niche, successive consortium members and their associated virulence determinants may serve as indirect microbial signatures of CRC progression. Recognizing CRC-associated oral communities as structured, interactive ecosystems has important diagnostic and therapeutic implications. Simultaneous detection of pathobionts, their cooperative clusters, and functionally relevant virulence determinants may improve microbiome-based risk stratification. Moreover, targeted disruption of bridging functions, interspecies interactions, or virulence factor activity may offer a precision strategy to weaken carcinogenic consortia without broad, dysbiosis-promoting antimicrobial pressure.

papers.title_zh: 口腔微生物群在大腸直腸癌發生中的貢獻：多菌種交互作用與毒力決定因子
papers.abstract_zh: 微生物群對散發性大腸直腸癌（CRC）的貢獻，傳統上是透過偵測個別腫瘤富集菌種或單一毒力因子來詮釋。然而，累積的證據顯示，CRC相關微生物常以結構化的多菌種共生體（polymicrobial consortia）形式作用，而非獨立作用因子。本綜述提出一個擴展的生態學框架，用以理解口腔菌種在大腸直腸癌發生中的角色。口腔細菌，包括梭桿菌屬（Fusobacterium）、小類桿菌屬（Parvimonas）、消化鏈球菌屬（Peptostreptococcus）、牙齦卜氏菌屬（Porphyromonas）、普雷沃氏菌屬（Prevotella）、鏈球菌屬（Streptococcus）及相關菌種，可能透過腸道或血行途徑轉位至大腸直腸微環境，並建立部分重現口腔生物膜結構組織與演替模式的腫瘤相關群落。在這些群落中，具核梭桿菌（Fusobacterium nucleatum）為主要橋接生物，促進跨菌種黏附與空間組織。微小類桿菌（Parvimonas micra）、牙齦卜氏菌（Porphyromonas gingivalis）及白色念珠菌（Candida albicans）展現潛在的橋接結構與功能特性，其在協同致病性與腫瘤進展中的角色獲得大量實驗證據支持。我們整合三個互補的概念框架：口腔微生物複合體（腸道共豐度群組）、橋接生物，以及擴展的CRC驅動者-乘客模型。此綜合分析支持從以分類學為中心的詮釋，轉向以功能性毒力體（virulome）為基礎的觀點，其中菌種的角色由其生態位置、交互作用網絡與毒力決定因子所定義。關鍵口腔毒力因子參與生物膜形成、上皮黏附與侵襲、屏障破壞、免疫逃避、發炎調控、腫瘤微環境代謝重塑，以及轉移潛力。由於轉位口腔共生體的組成在大腸直腸微環境中逐漸改變，連續的共生體成員及其相關毒力決定因子，可能作為CRC進展的間接微生物標誌。將CRC相關口腔群落視為結構化、互動性生態系統，具有重要的診斷與治療意涵。同時偵測致病菌、其協同菌叢，以及功能相關的毒力決定因子，可能改善以微生物群為基礎的風險分層。此外，針對性破壞橋接功能、菌種間交互作用或毒力因子活性，可能提供一種精準策略，以削弱致癌共生體，而不需廣泛且促進菌群失調的抗菌壓力。

papers.title: Primary Ciliary Dyskinesia: A Suggested Pathway to Transition From Pediatric to Adult Care
papers.authors: Castro A, Collins M, Jain R, Walsh J, Alba-Suárez J, Rivera-Sánchez Y
papers.abstract: Primary ciliary dyskinesia (PCD) is a rare, genetically heterogeneous disorder characterized by motile ciliary dysfunction that impairs mucociliary clearance. Symptoms of PCD can include unexplained neonatal respiratory issues, chronic sino-otopulmonary symptoms, recurrent infections, bronchiectasis, and subfertility. It is expected that the number of adult patients with PCD is four times higher than the number of pediatric patients. There are no established guidelines for transitioning individuals with PCD from pediatric to adult clinics. Although the exact prevalence is difficult to determine, it is estimated that up to 13% of adults with non-CF bronchiectasis have PCD. The Six Core Elements of Health Care Transition, developed by Got Transition, funded by the National Alliance to Advance Adolescent Health, and endorsed by the American Academy of Pediatrics, the American Academy of Family Physicians, and the American College of Physicians, can serve as a framework for transitioning PCD patients to adult care. Programs implementing the Six Core Elements have significantly reduced care dropouts during adolescence and early adulthood and increased engagement in care in early adulthood. PCD has been the subject of growing research aimed at improving diagnostic methods, treatments, and awareness, leading to earlier and more accurate diagnoses in both children and adults. Additionally, more adult PCD centers are seeking accreditation from the PCD Foundation and collaborating with pediatric centers to ensure continuity of care. Although many chronic diseases, such as cystic fibrosis (CF), inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), and, more recently, sickle cell disease, have established transition guidelines, PCD presents unique challenges that affect the transition process, as discussed in this work. We outline a pathway for transitioning pediatric patients with PCD to adult care.
papers.title_zh: 原發性纖毛運動障礙（PCD）：建議之兒童轉銜成人照護路徑
papers.abstract_zh: 原發性纖毛運動障礙（PCD）是一種罕見、基因異質性疾病，特徵為動纖毛功能障礙，損害黏液纖毛清除功能。PCD 的症狀可包括不明原因的新生兒呼吸問題、慢性鼻竇-耳-肺部症狀、反覆感染、支氣管擴張症及生育力低下。預期成人 PCD 患者人數將是兒童患者的四倍。目前尚無已建立的指引來協助 PCD 病人從兒科轉銜至成人門診。雖然確切盛行率難以確定，但估計高達 13% 的非囊性纖維化支氣管擴張症成人患者患有 PCD。由 Got Transition 發展、由 National Alliance to Advance Adolescent Health 資助、並經美國兒科學會、美國家庭醫師學會與美國內科醫師學會背書的「健康照護轉銜六大核心要素」，可作為 PCD 病人轉銜至成人照護的架構。實施六大核心要素的計畫已顯著減少青少年及成年早期的照護中斷，並提高成年早期的照護參與度。PCD 已成為日益增長的研究主題，旨在改善診斷方法、治療及認知度，使兒童與成人皆能更早、更準確地被診斷。此外，越來越多成人 PCD 中心尋求 PCD 基金會的認證，並與兒科中心合作以確保照護的連續性。雖然許多慢性疾病，如囊性纖維化（CF）、發炎性腸道疾病（IBD），以及近期的鐮刀型細胞疾病，已建立轉銜指引，但 PCD 存在影響轉銜過程的獨特挑戰，本文將加以討論。我們概述了一條 PCD 兒童病人轉銜至成人照護的路徑。

papers.title: Nutrition as Modulator of Oxidative Stress in Cancer Prevention and Treatment
papers.authors: Vallorani L, Balashova T, Cremon C, Vivarelli F, Canistro D, Morosini C
papers.abstract: Cancer remains a leading global cause of morbidity and mortality, with oxidative stress playing a central role in its pathogenesis, progression, and response to therapy. Nutrition has emerged as a modifiable factor capable of influencing redox homeostasis, thereby contributing to both cancer prevention and therapeutic outcomes. This narrative review summarizes current evidence on dietary patterns, specific nutrients, and bioactive compounds that modulate oxidative stress and are associated with reduced cancer risk and improved response to treatment. A literature search was conducted using PubMed, Scopus, and Google Scholar, covering the period from 2002 to 2025 to capture contemporary dietary approaches and clinical evidence. Eligible studies addressed nutrient compounds, dietary strategies, obesity, gut microbiota, conventional cancer therapies, and clinical outcomes, with particular emphasis on mechanisms related to oxidative stress, inflammation, and immune modulation. Epidemiological evidence consistently supports the protective role of plant-based dietary patterns and reduced intake of red and processed meat, partly due to their antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Nutrients such as dietary fiber, polyphenols, and omega-3 fatty acids are associated with decreased oxidative damage, improved immune responses, and enhanced therapeutic efficacy across multiple tumor types, including colorectal, breast, lung, and ovarian cancers, as well as glioblastoma. Emerging data also suggest that dietary interventions, including ketogenic diets and fasting, may influence tumor metabolism and redox balance, potentially increasing sensitivity to conventional therapies. The gut microbiota has been identified as a key mediator linking diet, oxidative stress, and cancer-related pathways. Although current evidence supports the role of nutritional strategies in targeting oxidative stress for cancer prevention and treatment, further large-scale randomized clinical trials are required to clarify their impact on survival and treatment efficacy. The integration of nutritional counseling into oncology practice represents a cost-effective, accessible, and patient-centered approach with the potential to modulate oxidative stress and improve clinical outcomes.

papers.title_zh: 營養作為氧化壓力調節因子於癌症預防與治療之角色
papers.abstract_zh: 癌症仍是全球主要的病殘與死亡原因，氧化壓力在其致病機轉、疾病進展及治療反應中扮演核心角色。營養已成為可調控氧化還原恆定的可改變因子，進而影響癌症預防與治療結果。本敘述性回顧總結目前關於飲食型態、特定營養素及生物活性化合物調節氧化壓力並與降低癌症風險及改善治療反應相關之證據。文獻搜尋涵蓋PubMed、Scopus及Google Scholar，時間範圍為2002至2025年，以掌握當代飲食方法與臨床證據。納入研究涉及營養化合物、飲食策略、肥胖、腸道菌相、傳統癌症治療及臨床結果，特別著重與氧化壓力、發炎及免疫調節相關之機轉。流行病學證據一致支持植物性飲食型態及減少紅肉與加工肉攝取的保護作用，部分歸因於其抗氧化與抗發炎特性。膳食纖維、多酚及omega-3脂肪酸等營養素與降低氧化損傷、改善免疫反應及提升多種腫瘤（包括大腸直腸癌、乳癌、肺癌、卵巢癌及神經膠質母細胞瘤）之治療效果相關。新興資料亦顯示，包括生酮飲食與斷食在內的飲食介入，可能影響腫瘤代謝與氧化還原平衡，進而潛在增加對傳統治療的敏感性。腸道菌相已被認定為連結飲食、氧化壓力與癌症相關路徑的關鍵中介者。儘管目前證據支持營養策略在針對氧化壓力進行癌症預防與治療上的角色，仍需大規模隨機臨床試驗以釐清其對存活與治療效果的影響。將營養諮詢整合入腫瘤照護實務，代表一種具成本效益、可近用且以病人為中心的方法，具有調節氧化壓力並改善臨床結果的潛力。

papers.title: Auricular Vagus Nerve Stimulation in Inflammatory Bowel Disease: Mechanistic Insights and Biomarker-Based Evaluation of Therapeutic Response
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), encompassing Crohn's disease (CD) and ulcerative colitis (UC), is a chronic inflammatory disorder characterized by dysregulated host-microbiota interactions, epithelial barrier dysfunction, and aberrant immune activation. Despite advances in biologic and small-molecule therapies, a substantial proportion of patients exhibit incomplete response, loss of response, or treatment-related adverse effects, underscoring the need for novel adjunctive therapeutic approaches. The vagus nerve exerts a pivotal effects on immune homeostasis through the cholinergic anti-inflammatory pathway, thereby integrating peripheral immune sensing with central autonomic regulation. Within the context of IBD, a diminution in vagal tone has been observed to correlate with persistent mucosal inflammation and immune dysregulation. Transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (ta-VNS) is a non-invasive neuromodulation technique that may activate vagal circuits and modulate neuroimmune signaling without surgical intervention. This review endeavors to critically evaluate the potential efficacy of ta-VNS in the context of IBD, with particular emphasis on its discernible effects on immune, epithelial barrier, microbiota-related, and autonomic biomarkers. Emerging evidence, stemming from preliminary investigations, suggests that ta-VNS may exert an influence on inflammatory cytokine profiles, epithelial tight junction integrity, gut microbial composition, and systemic autonomic balance, warranting further elucidation. In addition, the review discusses differential responses between Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, summarizes current preclinical and clinical evidence, and highlights biomarker-based strategies for evaluating therapeutic response in future randomized controlled trials. Although current evidence remains preliminary and stimulation parameters are not yet standardized, ta-VNS represents a promising adjunctive neuroimmune modulation strategy in IBD.

papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD），包含克隆氏症（CD）與潰瘍性結腸炎（UC），是一種以宿主-微生物群交互作用失調、上皮屏障功能障礙及異常免疫活化為特徵的慢性發炎性疾病。儘管生物製劑與小分子藥物治療已有進展，仍有相當比例的病人出現反應不完全、反應喪失或治療相關副作用，凸顯出開發新型輔助治療方法的必要性。迷走神經透過膽鹼性抗發炎路徑對免疫恆定發揮關鍵作用，將周邊免疫感測與中樞自律神經調節加以整合。在IBD情境下，迷走神經張力下降已被觀察到與持續性黏膜發炎及免疫失調相關。經皮耳穴迷走神經刺激（ta-VNS）是一種非侵入性神經調節技術，可能在不需手術介入的情況下活化迷走神經迴路並調節神經免疫訊號。本綜述旨在批判性評估ta-VNS於IBD中的潛在療效，特別著重於其對免疫、上皮屏障、微生物相關及自律神經生物標記的可辨識影響。來自初步研究的新興證據顯示，ta-VNS可能影響發炎性細胞激素圖譜、上皮緊密連接完整性、腸道微生物組成及全身自律神經平衡，值得進一步闡明。此外，本綜述討論克隆氏症與潰瘍性結腸炎之間的差異性反應，總結目前的臨床前與臨床證據，並強調未來隨機對照試驗中以生物標記為基礎的療效評估策略。儘管目前證據仍屬初步階段，且刺激參數尚未標準化，ta-VNS代表IBD中一種有前景的輔助性神經免疫調節策略。

papers.title: Patient-Derived Organoids in Gastrointestinal Disease: Current Applications, Limitations, and Future Perspectives
papers.authors: Caruso A, Hamrouni Y, Delvecchio A, Memeo R, Martinotti S
papers.abstract: The development of patient-derived organoids (PDOs) has substantially advanced the study of gastrointestinal diseases by providing three-dimensional human models that faithfully recapitulate the structural, molecular, and functional characteristics of native tissues. Unlike conventional two-dimensional cultures and animal models, intestinal organoids preserve epithelial architecture, cellular heterogeneity, and patient-specific genetic features, enabling more physiologically relevant investigations of gastrointestinal physiology and disease. Recent technological advances, including co-culture systems, organoid-derived monolayers, and organ-on-chip platforms, have further expanded their ability to model epithelial interactions with immune cells, stromal components, and the gut microbiota. These developments have facilitated mechanistic studies of epithelial barrier function, host-microbiota communication, microbial metabolites, and endocrine signaling, while also supporting translational applications in inflammatory bowel disease, infectious disorders, inherited gastrointestinal diseases, and gastrointestinal cancers. Moreover, patient-derived organoids have emerged as promising platforms for drug screening, biomarker discovery, precision medicine, and regenerative therapies. Despite these advances, several challenges remain, including limited representation of the native tissue microenvironment, lack of standardized culture protocols, scalability, and regulatory issues that currently restrict routine clinical implementation. This review summarizes recent progress in gastrointestinal organoid technology, highlighting current applications, emerging experimental platforms, and future perspectives for integrating organoid-based models into translational research and personalized medicine.

papers.abstract_zh: 病人來源類器官（PDOs）的發展，透過提供能忠實重現原生組織結構、分子與功能特徵的三維人類模型，已大幅推進胃腸道疾病之研究。相較於傳統二維培養與動物模型，腸道類器官能保留上皮結構、細胞異質性與病人特異性基因特徵，使胃腸生理學與疾病之研究更具生理相關性。近期技術進展，包括共培養系統、類器官衍生單層細胞模型，以及器官晶片平台，進一步擴展了其模擬上皮與免疫細胞、基質成分及腸道微生物群交互作用之能力。這些進展促進了上皮屏障功能、宿主-微生物溝通、微生物代謝物與內分泌訊號傳遞之機轉研究，同時也支持發炎性腸道疾病、感染性疾病、遺傳性胃腸疾病及胃腸道癌症之轉譯應用。此外，病人來源類器官已成為藥物篩選、生物標記發現、精準醫療與再生治療之潛力平台。儘管有這些進展，仍存在若干挑戰，包括對原生組織微環境代表性有限、缺乏標準化培養方案、可擴展性問題，以及限制其常規臨床應用之法規議題。本綜述總結了胃腸道類器官技術之近期進展，重點介紹現有應用、新興實驗平台，以及將類器官模型整合入轉譯研究與精準醫療之未來展望。
